sermon.title: Transformation - March 3, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. Zacharias was changed through nine months of silence, Gideon went from the least to a deliverer, Rahab went from prostitute to an ancestor of David, and dry bones became an army. We were made to be God’s dwelling place, not artificially changed, and God can put any broken life back together.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God will shine forth.
“Gather My saints together to Me, Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”

faqs.question: Was it exactly nine months?
faqs.answer: He says it could have been 38 weeks or 40.

faqs.question: What does he call Zacharias’s silence?
faqs.answer: A couples’ therapy moment where they can’t communicate and he has to write everything down.

faqs.question: Should spouses fight over every detail?
faqs.answer: No; let’s not make a fight about every little thing.

faqs.question: Did Gideon need special strength to tear down the idol?
faqs.answer: No; there were no miracles; he just had to decide.

faqs.question: Are these just stories?
faqs.answer: Even in 2024 they are fulfillments God wants to do in your life.

faqs.question: Do animals carry God’s presence?
faqs.answer: You don’t meet a gorilla with the presence of the Lord; maybe the donkey.

faqs.question: What if I feel dry as a Christian?
faqs.answer: Wherever you are, God can bring you together.

faqs.question: How precise were the dry bones?
faqs.answer: Each person needed the right bones; you can’t walk around with half a femur.

faqs.question: What is the closing word?
faqs.answer: God can bring you back together no matter how many pieces your life has been shattered in.
